name: Returning Fang Stance
description: Throw a homing blade that returns and immediately relaunches. Attack speed makes it travel faster. Each extra projectile adds 25% damage instead. Choose one Ninja stance per run.

name: Barrage Stance
description: Unleash rapid volleys with 2 additional projectiles and 65% more attack speed, but 40% less damage. Choose one Ninja stance per run.

name: Great Shuriken Stance
description: Throw a giant blade that pierces enemies and hits repeatedly. Gain 50% damage, but attack 50% slower. Each extra projectile adds 12% blade size instead. Choose one Ninja stance per run.

name: Cutting Return
description: Returning Fang also strikes enemies on its way back to you.

name: Relentless Fang
description: Returning Fang deals 15% more damage with each consecutive outward hit against the same enemy, up to 75% more.

name: Final Pursuit
description: When Returning Fang kills an enemy, it seeks one more nearby target before returning.

name: Focused Volley
description: Your volleys have 65% less spread, concentrating their fire.

name: Crescendo
description: Gain 1 extra projectile every 3 attacks, up to 5. Fire at full strength, then build up again. Each additional rank raises the limit by 2.

name: Needle Rain
description: Every fourth volley fires twice as many projectiles.

name: Serrated Edge
description: Each successive hit from the same Great Shuriken deals 15% more damage to that enemy, up to 75% more.

name: Grinding Halt
description: Great Shuriken slows for 0.6 seconds when it first hits an elite or boss, giving it time to strike again.

name: Growing Shuriken
description: Great Shuriken grows as it travels, reaching twice its size after 10 meters.

name: Breaking Wheel
description: When a Great Shuriken fades, it scatters 6 blades toward nearby enemies. Each deals 30% of its damage.

name: Embedded Blades
description: Ninja hits embed blades in enemies, up to 12 per enemy. On death, they scatter toward nearby foes for 40% of their original hit damage. Scattered blades cannot embed again.

name: Sharper Fragments
description: Embedded blades deal 20% more damage.

name: Barbed Blades
description: Embed 1 additional blade with each hit.

name: Scattering Blades
description: Scattered blades seek enemies from 15% farther away.
format: Scattered blades seek enemies from {Percent}% farther away.

name: Forked Blades
description: Projectiles split on impact into 2 blades, each dealing 50% damage. These blades cannot split again.

name: Heavy Shuriken
description: Great Shuriken travels 20% slower.

name: Lingering Shuriken
description: Great Shuriken stays in flight 30% longer.
